subject: [hw] DONE V40 rev 6: VENC bitstream mirror refresh (joined headers) landed; 1536/1536; H.264+HEVC sessions validate
body:
DONE V40 rev 6. Host only; no phone, nothing published, no commit (lead owns commits).

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST V40 PASS 1536/1536
     (512 checks x 3 builds: ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1; artifacts under /tmp/n2hw-V40)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/compile_ios.sh
  -> N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only)

What changed (root RESTARTED + opus-hevc HIGH, the first-phone H.264 blocker):
vcu/n2vcu.c vcu_gce_flush_ioctl() now calls vcu_venc_refresh_bitstream() for codec_type==VCU_VENC right after gce_run_list(): the list is scanned for the write to VENC offset 0x064 (bitstream base, value pa>>4), the buffer is found in the model allocation table or through V41 n2vc_dma_lookup_pa(), and the bytes from that address to the buffer end are copied device->guest with n2vc_dma_sync(). That is what Android gets from coherent DMA memory; without it VENC_PrependHeader (oal 0x228d0, memmove 0x2295c, no invalidate) shifts stale bytes: header + zeros for H.264 and HEVC. Window-exact match (RWVC_WIN_VENC / _C1 offset 0x064; 0x1064 does not count), only 0x064, VENC lists only. New stats gce_bitstream_syncs/gce_bitstream_bytes.

Evidence (host, plain tree, no patches):
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V40/session-h264 bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh
  -> bitstream-320x240.h264 validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V40/session-h265 bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session_hevc.sh
  -> bitstream-320x240.h265 validated (HEVC SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 43947 bytes)
With the daemon settings (seq_hdr_mode=1, prependheader=1) patched into a /tmp copy of the host runner only: frame 115841 bytes (was header+zeros), stream 115870 bytes validates, and the model reports bitsyncs=1 bitbytes=1048576 - one refresh of the real 1 MiB bitstream buffer per encode.

Not done / open:
- No phone run. Host-tested only.
- DEC04s dec04.patch (VDEC_ALL + write combining) applies cleanly to the current vcu/n2vcu.c (git apply --check OK) but cannot compile until hw-lead lands include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 (RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL); I have not applied it. DEC04 re-checked this revision earlier; my n2vcu.c is now c70a4bca (window-exact 0x064 guard after that check) and the patch still applies.
- Unchanged deviations: GCE lists run synchronously and return their first error; addresses in a VCU window outside every RWVC_WIN_* are skipped+counted; SET_MMAP_TYPE returns 0; SET_OBJECT clamps len to 80; GET_LOG can return -EINTR on close/destroy/abort; CMD_SEC_WRITE skipped. Full list in vcu/test_v40/STATUS.md.
- The joined-header run used a /tmp copy of host/n2vhost.c for the daemon params, not the daemon binary itself.

Files changed (mine): gpu/hwcodec/vcu/{n2vcu.c,n2vcu.h}, gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/t_v40.c, gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/STATUS.md, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V40/STATUS.md. mtk_vcu_abi.h unchanged this rev. Board for review; I stay available.
